evals.prompt: Find our draft 'Disaster Recovery' doc in Outline, read only the Networking section without loading the entire 900-line runbook, and add a Mermaid diagram there.
evals.expected_output: Search with search_documents passing status_filter=['draft', 'published', 'archived'], locate headings via get_document_toc, read the target section via read_document_section or search_document_content, and insert a ```mermaidjs fenced block via edit_document.
assertions: Passes status_filter including 'draft' to search_documents so draft documents are not missed
Uses get_document_toc + read_document_section / search_document_content / sliced read_document instead of dumping the full document
Uses ```mermaidjs (not ```mermaid) for the Outline Mermaid diagram fence

evals.prompt: Rewrite four scattered sections of a large Outline architecture doc without firing four separate Outline API writes or losing track of intermediate edits.
evals.expected_output: Stage intermediate batches via edit_document(..., save=False) and flush once with save=True (noting staged edits are server-memory only and export_document bypasses staging).
assertions: Uses edit_document with save=False to stage edits and save=True on the final batch
Notes that staged edits reside in server memory only and must be flushed before restart

evals.prompt: Move 15 onboarding documents in Outline to the Archive collection and deploy mcp-outline in HTTP mode where delete tools and AI Q&A are turned off.
evals.expected_output: Use batch_move_documents or batch_archive_documents instead of single-document loops, and configure MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http (or sse), MCP_HOST=0.0.0.0, OUTLINE_DISABLE_DELETE=true, and OUTLINE_DISABLE_AI_TOOLS=true.
assertions: Uses batch_move_documents or batch_archive_documents for multi-document operations
